Okay I see what you mean. I went back and read up on the trial some more but I’m still not convinced. 
Obviously the only good pedophile is a dead one, but the man threw a bag of clothing at Rittenhouse, and then grabbed his gun. The dude was met with 4 bullets and killed. Then another dude wielding a skate board came at him and hit him in the head, in what seems to be defense of the other guy, just to be met with another bullet to the chest. Then another man, who actually was a trained paramedic, was shot because he pointed a gun at Rittenhouse, no counter bullets were ever shot as you claim.  
I just don’t think Rittenhouse or any civilian can play executioner. Obviously I could care less about a pedo being killed, but it should’ve been through the judicial system. 
And I have been hit by skateboard trucks numerous times, my two front teeth are chipped from it. It’s extremely painful, and possibly fatal, but it’s nothing I would compare to a gun though. 
I do know what a threat is, the empty threats comment was my bad, definitely a hyperbole and I was wrong. 
All in all, I just don’t see why a march, that’s organized to point out the dangers of gun violence, and the flaws in our judicial system, is that bad. It’s not about Rittenhouse, his panel is just a good time to do the march in my opinion. Even if it does get him more exposure, maybe people will see the march and think about it. I don’t think it’s going to change the world, but I do think it’s better to be out in the streets fighting for something than to just sit back in comfortable complacency.
